$comment: AgentNotify harness example for Gemini CLI. Merge the hooks object into your real settings file (~/.gemini/settings.json for you, or <repo>/.gemini/settings.json for a project) and replace HOOK_DIR with the folder holding agentnotify_hook.py. Prefer `agentnotify install-harness gemini` so the merge is idempotent and your other hooks survive. All three events are advisory: the hook only notifies and never blocks.
